source.name: AAMC Postbaccalaureate Premedical Programs Database
source.notes: Retrieved from the AAMC Postbac program API (api.mec.aamc.org/postbac-service/services-rs/programs/), which is the same data backing the mec.aamc.org/postbac Angular SPA. Only active programs (status=A) included; 338 total. The live API was directly accessible despite the SPA shell’s Angular front-end previously failing at TLS level — the underlying REST service at api.mec.aamc.org was reachable on 2026-08-07. externalId is the AAMC program ID.
